```{r favorite-color-summary, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
suppressWarnings(
  suppressMessages(
    params$dfADSL |>
      dplyr::mutate(
        COLOR_CLASS = factor(.data$COLOR_CLASS, levels = c("Primary", "Secondary"))
      ) |>
      dplyr::select(COLOR_CLASS) |>
      gtsummary::tbl_summary(
        statistic = gtsummary::all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)",
        missing = "no"
      ) |>
      gtsummary::modify_header(label ~ "**Color Class**") |>
      gtsummary::bold_labels()
  )
)
```
